variable_coverage.construction: Compounded fiscal-year buy-and-hold `RET` less aligned CRSP value-weighted return; use Compustat fiscal-year dates and effective-dated GVKEY–PERMNO link.
EPS before extraordinary items in year t divided by fiscal-year-end share price at t−1.
Change in EPS before extraordinary items from t−1 to t divided by the fiscal-year-end share price at t−1.
Operating income before interest divided by average NOA; derive operating assets and liabilities from the paper’s item-number formula.
RNOA_t minus RNOA_{t−1}; nested average-NOA ratios require raw statements through t−2.
Operating income before interest divided by total sales in year t.
Sales divided by average NOA_t and NOA_{t−1}.
PM_t minus PM_{t−1}; current and prior-year operating income and sales.
ATO_t minus ATO_{t−1}; because each ATO uses average NOA, raw inputs extend through t−2.
Future RNOA_{t+1}; t+1 operating income and average NOA require statements through t+1.
Future PM_{t+1}: operating income before interest divided by sales in t+1.
Future ATO_{t+1}: sales in t+1 divided by average NOA_{t+1} and NOA_t.

review_notes: All three baseline results use the common 1984–2002 fiscal-year cohort and the Compustat, CRSP and I/B/E/S source families. The sample requires nonmissing I/B/E/S, Compustat and contemporaneous/future CRSP data, excludes SIC 6000–6999 and negative NOA/operating income, and yields 38,716 firm-years.

Original short-window return is around the actual annual earnings announcement; the event date must come from announcement data rather than being substituted with fiscal year end. The source does not bound the last cohort’s calendar announcement date.
Shared probes establish field presence only. No local source coverage confirmations were supplied; historical coverage remains unverified.
